intended_object: The closed unit square [0,1]² ⊂ ℝ², used as the closed fundamental cell of the 2-torus for compactness and periodic integration. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: In this library `Vec 2` is `Fin 2 → ℝ`. The definition `Set.pi univ (fun _ => Icc 0 1)` is the product of two copies of [0,1], which is exactly the closed unit square. It also equals the order interval `Set.Icc 0 1` in the product order on `Fin 2 → ℝ` (Mathlib's `Set.pi_univ_Icc`), so the formulation is equivalent to the standard one. The definition is a specific object: the unit cell of the 2-dimensional torus that this file works with. Fixing the dimension to 2 is therefore not undue narrowness. Mathlib has no separately named definition of this cell.
